title: if I knew … I wish I knew …

exercises.instruction: Put the verb into the correct form.

parts: you if I could, but I'm afraid I can't.
(it / taste) better if it wasn't so salty.
We live in a city and don't need a car, but we would need one if
I'd make a lot of changes if
(I / be) the manager of the company.
I wouldn't call someone in the middle of the night if
You're always tired because you go to bed so late. If
(you / not / go) to bed so late every night,
(you / not / be) tired all the time.
I think there are too many cars. If
We all need jobs and money, but what

exercises.instruction: Write a sentence with if … for each situation.

items.prompt: I like these shoes but they're too expensive, so I'm not going to buy them.
answers: I'd buy them if they weren't so expensive.
I would buy them if they weren't so expensive.

items.prompt: We'd like to go on holiday, but we can't afford it.
answers: We'd go on holiday if we could afford it.
We would go on holiday if we could afford it.

items.prompt: It would be nice to have lunch outside but it's raining, so we can't.
answers: We could have lunch outside if it weren't raining.
We could have lunch outside if it wasn't raining.

items.prompt: I don't want his advice, and that's why I'm not going to ask for it.
answers: If I wanted his advice, I'd ask for it.
If I wanted his advice, I would ask for it.

items.prompt: I don't have much free time (and I need more).
answers: I wish I had more free time.

items.prompt: Helen isn't here (and I need to see her).
It's cold (and I hate cold weather).
answers: I wish it weren't so cold.
I wish it wasn't so cold.

items.prompt: I live in a big city (and I don't like it).
answers: I wish I didn't live in a big city.

items.prompt: I can't find my phone (which is a problem).
answers: I wish I could find my phone.

items.prompt: I'm not feeling well (which isn't good).
answers: I wish I was feeling well.
I wish I were feeling well.
I wish I was feeling better.
I wish I were feeling better.

items.prompt: I have to get up early tomorrow (but I'd prefer to sleep late).
answers: I wish I didn't have to get up early tomorrow.

items.prompt: I don't know much about science (and I should know more).
answers: I wish I knew more about science.

exercises.instruction: Write your own sentences beginning I wish … .

items.prompt: (somewhere you'd like to be now – on the beach, in New York, in bed etc.)
modelAnswers: I wish I was at home.

items.prompt: (something you'd like to have – a motorbike, more friends, lots of money etc.)
modelAnswers: I wish I had a big garden.

items.prompt: (something you'd like to be able to do – sing, travel more, cook etc.)
modelAnswers: I wish I could tell jokes.

items.prompt: (something you'd like to be – famous, more intelligent, good at sport etc.)
